description.narrative:
The project aims to modernize Senegal's cities by providing them with quality infrastructures to improve populations' living environment of the populations.
The specific objectives of the project are to: (i) enhance the access of urban populations to acceptable level of solid waste management services; (ii) improve mobility of populations by providing them with all-weather access to social services, (iii) protect the population against recurrent flooding by strengthening the storm water drainage system; (iv) enhance public safety and productivity of economic activities through installation of street lighting systems; and (v) improve the physical environment of regional cities and their livability through provision of appropriate public spaces and green landscaping.
